filler_lines: इस टॉपिक के पूरे नोट्स चाहिए? नोट्स का लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है, नोट्स ज़रूर ले लीजिए।
प्रैक्टिस के लिए मॉक टेस्ट चाहिए? मॉक्स का लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है, मॉक्स ज़रूर ले लीजिए।
नोट्स और मॉक्स, दोनों के लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में मौजूद हैं, उन्हें लेना मत भूलिए।
रिवीज़न के लिए नोट्स लीजिए, और परीक्षा जैसी प्रैक्टिस के लिए मॉक्स लीजिए, लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
जो प्रश्न अभी छूट गए, उनके नोट्स डिस्क्रिप्शन में दिए लिंक से ले लीजिए।
हर हफ्ते मॉक टेस्ट हल करने से स्कोर बढ़ता है, मॉक्स का लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
अगर अब तक के प्रश्न सही रहे, तो मॉक्स लेकर अपना स्तर और परखिए, लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
नोट्स लेना न भूलें, लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है, और अपने दोस्तों को भी बताइए।
कंप्यूटर के प्रश्नों पर पकड़ मज़बूत करनी है? तो नोट्स लीजिए, लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
वीडियो पसंद आ रहा है तो लाइक कीजिए, और नोट्स व मॉक्स के लिए डिस्क्रिप्शन का लिंक खोलिए।
मॉक टेस्ट हल करने की आदत डालिए, मॉक्स का लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है, अभी ले लीजिए।
चैनल Target1st को सब्सक्राइब कीजिए, नोट्स और मॉक्स का लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
ये पॉइंट नोट कर लीजिए, और पूरे नोट्स के लिए डिस्क्रिप्शन में दिया लिंक देखिए।
सिर्फ़ वीडियो देखना काफ़ी नहीं, मॉक्स भी हल कीजिए, लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में है।
नोट्स ले लो, मॉक्स ले लो, दोनों के लिंक डिस्क्रिप्शन में हैं, और तैयारी में जुट जाओ।

questions.q: Which of the following is a pointing device?
points: A pointing device controls the cursor on screen
Mouse, trackball, touchpad and joystick are pointing devices
Keyboard is mainly a text input device

questions.q: Which key combination switches between open windows in Windows?
points: Alt + Tab switches between open applications
Win + Tab opens Task View
Ctrl + Tab switches tabs inside a program

questions.q: Which unit is the largest?
points: Order: KB < MB < GB < TB < PB
Each step is 1024 times the previous one
1 TB = 1024 GB

questions.q: Which of the following is system software?
points: System software runs and controls the hardware
OS, device drivers and utilities are system software
MS Word, Tally and Photoshop are application software

questions.q: Which key is used to rename a selected file in Windows?
points: F2 renames the selected file or folder
F1 opens Help and F5 refreshes
F10 activates the menu bar

questions.q: Which type of printer uses a laser beam and toner?
points: Laser printers use toner and a laser beam
They give high speed and quality prints
Inkjet printers spray liquid ink

questions.q: BIOS stands for?
points: BIOS starts the computer and runs POST
It is stored in ROM or flash memory
It loads the operating system into RAM

questions.q: Which memory is permanent and read-only?
points: ROM retains data without power
It stores boot instructions such as BIOS
PROM, EPROM and EEPROM are types of ROM

questions.q: Which Windows tool is used to remove installed programs?
points: Uninstall programs from Control Panel or Settings > Apps
Disk Cleanup removes temporary files
Device Manager manages hardware drivers

questions.q: Which device connects computers in a LAN and sends data only to the intended device?
points: A switch learns MAC addresses
It forwards data only to the destination port
A hub broadcasts data to all ports

questions.q: Which of these is a valid MAC address length?
points: MAC address is 48 bits (6 bytes)
It is written in hexadecimal
It is burned into the network card

questions.q: Which command tests connectivity between two computers?
points: ping sends ICMP echo requests
It shows reply time and packet loss
tracert shows each hop on the route

questions.q: Which topology has a single backbone cable?
points: All devices share one common cable in a bus
Cable failure can stop the whole network
Terminators are used at both ends

questions.q: How many bits are in an IPv6 address?
points: IPv6 uses 128 bits
It is written in hexadecimal separated by colons
IPv6 solves the shortage of IPv4 addresses

questions.q: Which protocol translates domain names to IP addresses?
points: DNS means Domain Name System
It works like a phone book of the Internet
Example: google.com to an IP address

questions.q: Which of the following is a Class A IP address?
points: Class A starts from 1 to 126
10.x.x.x is a private Class A range
192.168.x.x is a private Class C range

questions.q: Which cable uses light to transmit data?
points: Optical fibre sends data as light pulses
It has very high speed and low signal loss
It is immune to electromagnetic interference

questions.q: The default subnet mask of a Class C network is?
points: Class C mask is 255.255.255.0
Class A is 255.0.0.0 and Class B is 255.255.0.0
It allows 254 host addresses

questions.q: Which Windows feature creates a restore point to undo system changes?
points: System Restore returns the system to an earlier state
It does not delete personal files
It is useful after a faulty install

questions.q: Which key opens the Start menu?
points: The Windows key opens the Start menu
Ctrl + Esc also opens it
Win + X opens the power-user menu

questions.q: Which shortcut opens File Explorer?
points: Win + E opens File Explorer
Win + I opens Settings
Win + S opens Search

questions.q: What is a cookie in a web browser?
options: A small file storing site data on your computer
points: Websites store small text files called cookies
They remember login and preferences
Clearing cache and cookies is done from browser settings

questions.q: Which software is used to view web pages?
points: A browser requests and displays web pages
Chrome, Firefox and Edge are examples
Internet Explorer was an older browser

questions.q: Which of the following is a search engine?
points: A search engine finds web pages for a keyword
Bing and DuckDuckGo are also search engines
Opera is a browser, Outlook is a mail client

questions.q: In email, what does BCC mean?
points: BCC hides recipients from each other
CC shows all recipients to everyone
The To field holds the main recipient

questions.q: Which protocol is used to transfer files between computers on the Internet?
points: FTP means File Transfer Protocol
It commonly uses port 21
SFTP is its secure version

questions.q: Which port number is used by HTTP?
points: HTTP uses port 80
HTTPS uses port 443
FTP uses 21 and SMTP uses 25

questions.q: Which HTML tag is used to display an image?
points: is an empty tag
The src attribute gives the file path
alt gives alternate text

questions.q: Which HTML tag makes text bold?
points: <b> makes text bold
<i> makes text italic and <u> underlines it
<strong> also shows bold importance

questions.q: Which HTML attribute sets the destination of a link?
points: href means hypertext reference
It is used inside the <a> tag
src is used in

questions.q: Which tag contains the visible content of an HTML page?
points: <body> holds everything shown on the page
<head> holds information like title and meta
<title> text shows on the browser tab

questions.q: Which HTML tag creates a numbered list?
points: <ol> means ordered list
Each item is placed in <li>
<ul> makes bullets

questions.q: Which tag is used to create a form input box?
points: <input> creates text boxes, buttons and checkboxes
Its type attribute decides the kind of input
<textarea> gives a multi-line box

questions.q: Which CSS property changes the background colour?
points: Example: body { background-color: yellow; }
color changes text colour
CSS means Cascading Style Sheets

questions.q: Which JavaScript method shows a pop-up message box?
points: alert() shows a message with an OK button
confirm() asks OK or Cancel
prompt() asks the user to type input

questions.q: Which attribute makes a table cell span multiple columns?
points: colspan merges cells across columns
rowspan merges cells across rows
Both are used in <td> or <th>

questions.q: Which MS Word shortcut makes selected text bold?
points: Ctrl + B bold, Ctrl + I italic, Ctrl + U underline
Ctrl + E centres the text
Ctrl + L left aligns and Ctrl + R right aligns

questions.q: What is the default file extension of an MS Word 2016 document?
points: .docx is the default since Word 2007
.doc is the older format
.dotx is the template format

questions.q: Which MS Word feature automatically finds spelling mistakes?
points: Press F7 to run spelling and grammar check
Red wavy line marks spelling errors
Blue or green line marks grammar issues

questions.q: Which Excel function finds the largest number in a range?
points: MAX returns the largest value
MIN returns the smallest value
Example: =MAX(B2:B20)

questions.q: What is the intersection of a row and a column in Excel called?
points: A cell is the basic unit of a worksheet
Its address is like B3
A range is a group of cells like A1:C5

questions.q: Which Excel function returns the average of numbers?
points: AVERAGE adds numbers and divides by the count
Example: =AVERAGE(A1:A5)
MEDIAN gives the middle value

questions.q: Which Excel function returns the current date?
points: =TODAY() returns the current date
=NOW() returns date and time
The value updates every day

questions.q: Which PowerPoint view is best for rearranging slides?
points: Slide Sorter shows all slides as thumbnails
Drag and drop to change the order
Notes Page shows speaker notes

questions.q: Which shortcut inserts a new slide in PowerPoint?
points: Ctrl + M adds a new slide
Ctrl + N creates a new presentation
Ctrl + K inserts a hyperlink

questions.q: Default file extension of a PowerPoint presentation is?
points: .pptx is the default since PowerPoint 2007
.ppt is the older format
.pps opens directly in slide show mode

questions.q: Which Excel feature shows data in a chart-ready summary by grouping and totals?
points: PivotTable summarises large data quickly
Insert tab > PivotTable creates one
Freeze Panes keeps rows or columns visible

questions.q: What is a computer virus?
options: A harmful program that spreads and damages data
points: Viruses attach to files and replicate
Antivirus software detects and removes them
Keep the software updated for protection

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of a firewall function?
points: A firewall filters incoming and outgoing traffic
It can be hardware or software
It protects a network from intruders

questions.q: Which Windows utility arranges scattered file fragments on a hard disk to improve speed?
points: Defragmentation joins fragmented file pieces together
It improves read speed on a hard disk
SSDs do not need defragmentation, Windows only trims them
